AiMOGA schedules Mobo reveal and global preorders for October 21

The family companion emphasizes conversation, reminders and long-term memory; pricing and delivery remain unspecified.

GlobeNewswire ↗17 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A dated preorder plan

AiMOGA says Mobo will be unveiled in Wuhu, China, on October 21, with global preorders opening that day during the Chery International User Summit. This is a future schedule, not completed delivery.

Proposed interaction features

The company lists voice interaction, visual object recognition, schedule reminders and long-term memory. Its MoAgent software connects perception, interaction and task planning to support continuity across conversations and respond to requests.

Commercial details still pending

Mobo has appeared at earlier events; the new development is a firm reveal and preorder date. This release provides no price, delivery terms or independent household testing, so it does not establish immediate customer readiness for every advertised capability.
